min_clean_segments.description: Minimum number of clean segments (0 = continuous cleaning, > 0 = pause cleaning until less segments are available). Can be a percentage or absolute value with suffix.

max_clean_segments.description: Maximum number of clean segments. Can be a percentage or absolute value with suffix.

clean_check_interval.description: Clean segment check interval in seconds.

nsegments_per_clean.description: The maximum number of segments to be cleaned at a time.

mc_nsegments_per_clean.description: The maximum number of segments to be cleaned at a time if clean segments < min_clean_segments.

mc_cleaning_interval.description: Cleaning interval in seconds if clean segments < min_clean_segments.

min_reclaimable_blocks.description: Specify the minimum number of reclaimable blocks in a segment before it can be cleaned. Can be a percentage or absolute value with suffix.

mc_min_reclaimable_blocks.description: Specify the minimum number of reclaimable blocks in a segment before it can be cleaned if clean segments < min_clean_segments. Can be a percentage or absolute value with suffix.

use_set_suinfo.description: Enable set_suinfo ioctl if supported (needed for min_reclaimable_blocks).

use_mmap.description: Use mmap when reading segments if supported.

log_priority.description: Log priority. Supported priorities are emerg, alert, crit, err, warning, notice, info, and debug.
